questions.subject: MICROECONOMICS
questions.learningObjective: Explain when a trigger strategy holds
questions.stem: A study group asks when a trigger strategy sustains collusion.

options.text: When the discounted future gain exceeds the one-time cheating gain.
When cheating gain is larger than future gain.

questions.explanation: Collusion is sustained when the present value of future cooperative profits exceeds the one-time gain from cheating.
